old_problem: The historical record awaited whether Load Defaults means factory or project/recipe values, plus a safe Processor Configuration matrix and recovery; another similar row cannot supply this variant's evidence.
disposition_reason: ED-11 prohibits all/random and requires safe reversible settings one at a time. ED-24 requires an explicit per-case Factory Default versus Project Recipe target and forbids treating them as equivalent. Those rulings resolve the core semantics: this variant carries a required DEFAULT_TARGET parameter and, when Project Recipe is intended, a separately approved recipe-application/restoration step after firmware Load Defaults. Exact values remain runtime configuration.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2183, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, ED-11, ED-24 and all ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2184 / Wistron-BIOS-00501-V002 / 56d69c503ee6db5b was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Preserve this source/variant and collect its own evidence; do not inherit row 2176 completion or screenshots.
Bind DEFAULT_TARGET as FACTORY_DEFAULT or PROJECT_RECIPE with separate authoritative matrices; never conflate them.
Reject all/random; change one approved reversible Processor Configuration value or dependency group.
If target is Project Recipe, firmware Load Defaults output is recorded separately, then approved recipe application is required before project comparison.
Operator controls KVM/save/reboot/default/recipe/recovery; verify CPU/socket/core/thread/NUMA and preserved logs each phase.
No BIOS value, log, reboot, Load Defaults, recipe, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: ED-24 independent Processor Configuration change-default and target-specific restoration
test_case.purpose: Independently prove an approved Processor Configuration change persists, then restore and verify the explicitly selected Factory Default or Project Recipe target without CPU-topology or boot-health regression.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and maintenance window
DEFAULT_TARGET plus separate factory and project matrices
Safe reversible value/dependency and CPU-topology oracle
Backup, recipe application and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery plan
test_case.test_command: For this row only, capture baseline and selected DEFAULT_TARGET matrix; change one approved reversible Processor Configuration value/group, save/reboot and prove retention plus CPU topology. Invoke firmware Load Defaults and record its factory result. If DEFAULT_TARGET=PROJECT_RECIPE, apply the separately approved recipe and reboot. Compare the final page, topology, boot and preserved error evidence to the selected target.
test_case.expected_result: The approved change persists; every reboot preserves expected CPU/socket/core/thread/NUMA and health; factory state is identified separately; final state exactly matches the selected Factory Default or Project Recipe matrix.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only against the declared DEFAULT_TARGET with row-specific screenshots and signed topology/error criteria. Factory values cannot satisfy a Project Recipe case. Wrong persistence/restoration, topology drift, boot failure or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing target/matrix/recovery is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until DEFAULT_TARGET, both relevant matrices, safe value, maintenance and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or unapproved security/provisioning changes.
Back up current project settings; preserve logs and row-specific evidence.
Operator controls every save/reboot/default/recipe/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11/ED-24 approval and platform identity
Declared DEFAULT_TARGET, factory/project matrices and safe value dependencies
Unique baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults, optional recipe and final screenshots
Per-phase POST/OS Ready and CPU/socket/core/thread/NUMA inventory
Backup/restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on boot/topology/error anomaly and preserve this row's evidence. Qualified personnel restore the backed-up last-known-good/project recipe through the signed KVM/physical/CMOS process; never reuse another variant's evidence or blindly retry.

blocked.reason: ED-11/24 define safe change and target semantics; exact matrices and recovery are runtime inputs.
